[IARC.11.2] **All monotonic counters and randomised state are preserved
exactly.** `fact_id`, `seq`, activation timetags, and every internal monotonic
counter **continue from the source's current values** — required for both
synthetic-id determinism and byte-identical divergence from the clone point
([IARC.11.3] / [LDET.2.2b]).
Series backings are copied **verbatim** — Welford `(n, mean, M2)`, ring/deque
contents, and the reservoir `xorshift64` **PRNG state** — so series are exact,
not cold-started (the [LDET.2.2a] warm-up bias is avoided). The TMS keys on
`fact_id` (a value), so it survives the copy directly.
